title.zh: 用可追溯记录核对异常
title.en: Trace a discrepancy to its source

intro.zh: 比较三种需要留下证据的工作。看你更愿意检查是否漏项、验证读数，还是把不同版本整理到可追溯。
intro.en: Compare three jobs that leave an audit trail. Which would you rather do: check for missing evidence, verify a reading, or make records traceable?

question.zh: 面对一份检查记录，你愿意逐项核对签核和附件吗？
question.en: Would you go through an inspection log to verify sign-offs and attachments?

question.zh: 你更愿意确认读数偏差来自测量条件还是仪器吗？
question.en: Would you rather check whether a discrepancy comes from the conditions or the instrument?

question.zh: 文件有三个版本时，你会先查哪一条修订记录？
question.en: When a document has three versions, which revision record would you check first?

title.zh: 比较记录核查与读数校准
title.en: Compare inspection records and calibration

brief.zh: 虚构记录：A 项有读数但无签名，B 项读数为 10.4，允许范围为 9.8–10.2。
brief.en: Fictional log: A has a reading but no signature. B reads 10.4, with an acceptable range of 9.8–10.2.

prompts.zh: 标出缺少的签核证据，并写一条交接说明。
prompts.en: Flag the missing sign-off and write a one-line handoff.

prompts.zh: 标出哪项读数要复测，并写下你会记录哪项测量条件。
prompts.en: Flag the reading to recheck and write down one measurement condition to record.

title.zh: 先找哪个故障线索
title.en: Choose which fault to investigate first

intro.zh: 比较诊断时如何从一个现象缩小范围。观察你更愿意查看控制信号、复现症状，还是选择合适的检测方式。
intro.en: Compare how each role narrows down a fault. Would you rather inspect a control signal, reproduce a symptom, or choose a way to test for defects?

question.zh: 设备反复停机时，你想先查哪个输入信号？
question.en: When a machine keeps stopping, which input signal would you check first?

question.zh: 面对偶发异响，你更愿意先复现症状还是核对记录？
question.en: With an intermittent noise, would you first reproduce it or check the service record?

question.zh: 工件不能拆解时，你怎样说明为什么选一种检测方法？
question.en: How would you justify a test when a part cannot be taken apart?

title.zh: 比较机器人与汽车故障诊断
title.en: Compare robot and vehicle diagnosis

brief.zh: 虚构记录：一台模型机器人只在转弯时停下，一台玩具车只在加速时异响。用纸面记录推理。
brief.en: Fictional logs: a model robot stops only when turning, and a toy vehicle makes a noise only when accelerating. Work through the evidence on paper.

prompts.zh: 选一条机器人信号记录先看，并写下哪个结果会推翻猜测。
prompts.en: Choose one robot signal to inspect and write down what result would change your mind.

prompts.zh: 选一项能区分两种汽车故障假设的纸面检查，说明为什么先做它。
prompts.en: Choose one paper-based check to separate two hypotheses and explain why it goes first.

title.zh: 把含糊的需求说清楚
title.en: Clarify what someone needs

intro.zh: 三种工作都要理解别人表达了什么，产出却不同：厘清选项、准确转述，或给出教学调整。
intro.en: Each job starts by understanding what someone means, then produces something different: clearer options, a faithful restatement, or a teaching change.

question.zh: 对方只说“我想换方向”时，你想先问清哪个条件？
question.en: If someone says “I want a different direction,” which condition would you clarify first?

question.zh: 你怎样保留原话的不确定性，避免替说话人作决定？
question.en: How would you preserve uncertainty without deciding for the speaker?

question.zh: 看完一节课后，你会用什么观察支持调整建议？
question.en: After observing a lesson, what evidence would support a change?

title.zh: 比较需求澄清与准确转述
title.en: Compare clarification and faithful restatement

brief.zh: 虚构选课陈述：“我想换一门轻一点的课，但还得赶上毕业。”
brief.en: Fictional course request: “I want a lighter course, but I still need to graduate on time.”

prompts.zh: 写三个问题，分别澄清工作量、先修要求和时间限制。
prompts.en: Write three questions about workload, prerequisites, and timing.

prompts.zh: 把这句话准确转述给第三方，标出一处仍不确定的意思。
prompts.en: Restate the request for a third party and flag one point that remains uncertain.

title.zh: 让下一位接手的人知道怎么办
title.en: Make the next step clear for someone else

intro.zh: 比较三种交接：协调支持资源、指引资料查找、把日常观察交给家长。哪一种细节最值得你反复确认？
intro.en: Compare three handoffs: coordinating support, finding information, and passing observations to a parent. Which details would you most want to verify?

question.zh: 接手一个服务请求时，你会怎样核对对方还需要什么支持？
question.en: When you receive a service request, how would you check what support is still needed?

question.zh: 你怎样判断读者需要一个检索提示，还是应交给馆员处理？
question.en: How would you tell whether someone needs a search hint or a librarian's help?

question.zh: 你会把哪一条日常观察写进交接记录，为什么？
question.en: Which everyday observation would you record for the next caregiver, and why?

title.zh: 比较服务交接与资料指引
title.en: Compare a support handoff and a research referral

brief.zh: 虚构请求：一位来访者要在周五前找到一份社区活动指南，但不确定负责机构。
brief.en: Fictional request: a visitor needs a community activity guide by Friday and is unsure which organization manages it.

prompts.zh: 写一张三栏交接单：已知事项、待核实事项、下一位联系人。
prompts.en: Write a three-column handoff: confirmed facts, open questions, and next contact.

prompts.zh: 写出三步查找路径，并标出哪一步之后应转给馆员。
prompts.en: List three search steps and mark when to refer the visitor to a librarian.

title.zh: 为同一个故事保留什么
title.en: Decide what a story needs to keep

intro.zh: 写作、编辑与视觉创作都会改变材料。比较你愿意从哪个角度表达，以及哪些意思在修订中应当保留。
intro.en: Writing, editing, and visual art all transform material. Compare the point of view you would choose and what you would preserve during revision.

question.zh: 你会用谁的视角来写，哪些细节能说明这个选择？
question.en: Whose point of view would you use, and which details would justify it?

question.zh: 原稿有一句不够清楚但很有作者特色，你会怎样处理？
question.en: How would you edit an unclear sentence that carries the author's voice?

question.zh: 如果只能用三种形状或颜色，哪一项最能表达主题？
question.en: If you could use only three shapes or colors, which would do most to convey the theme?

title.zh: 比较写作与编辑
title.en: Compare writing and editing

brief.zh: 虚构材料：雨停后，社区花园里最后一株被风吹倒的番茄苗又立了起来。
brief.en: Fictional material: after the rain, the last fallen tomato seedling in a community garden stood up again.

prompts.zh: 用第一人称写一小段故事，选一个能传达主题的细节。
prompts.en: Write a short first-person story and choose one detail that conveys its theme.

prompts.zh: 编辑这句草稿：“大家都说它不会再立起来，她没说话，只把木杆插回土里。”标出你会保留的表达。
prompts.en: Edit this line: “They all said it would stay down. She said nothing and pushed the stake back into the soil.” Mark one expression you would keep.

title.zh: 设计一个能区分解释的检验
title.en: Design a test that separates explanations

intro.zh: 三个职业都需要把假设和观测对起来，所用的材料分别是程序表现、材料读数和实物证据。
intro.en: All three roles test explanations against observations, using software behavior, material readings, or physical evidence.

question.zh: 两个程序都报慢，你会怎样控制变量来比较？
question.en: If two programs are reported as slow, which variable would you control first?

question.zh: 两份材料读数差异很大时，你会先复测哪一个条件？
question.en: When two material readings differ sharply, which condition would you recheck first?

question.zh: 你会记录什么信息，便于别人复核检验结果？
question.en: What would you record so someone else could check the result?

title.zh: 比较软件对照与材料复测
title.en: Compare a software experiment and a materials retest

brief.zh: 虚构读数：样本 A 为 8、9、8，B 为 8、14、9。B 的第二次记录环境不同。
brief.en: Fictional readings: A is 8, 9, 8 and B is 8, 14, 9. The second B reading was taken under different conditions.

prompts.zh: 把两组读数当作响应时间，写下一个控制变量和判定规则。
prompts.en: Treat the readings as response times. Name one control variable and a decision rule.

prompts.zh: 把两组读数当作材料测试，写下先复测哪一项及怎样记录条件。
prompts.en: Treat the readings as material test results. Pick a first retest and say how you would document its conditions.

title.zh: 观察形态与节奏怎样改变观感
title.en: See how form and rhythm change a first impression

intro.zh: 比较色彩、镜头和材质三种表达手段。你愿意花时间打磨哪一种变化，并怎样看出它有效？
intro.en: Compare three ways to shape an impression: color, shot order, and material. Which would you refine, and what would count as improvement?

question.zh: 同一个桌面，怎样用形态和颜色把注意力引到中心？
question.en: How would you use form and color to direct attention to the center of a table?

question.zh: 去掉一个镜头会让信息更清楚，还是让情绪少一层？
question.en: Would removing one shot clarify the message or flatten its emotional tone?

question.zh: 哪一种表面处理最能保留材料原有的触感？
question.en: Which finish would best preserve the material's texture?

title.zh: 比较花艺构图与视频分镜
title.en: Compare floral arrangement and video sequencing

brief.zh: 虚构主题：“安静的早晨”。材料只用纸笔，不需要花材或影片。
brief.en: Fictional brief: “A quiet morning.” Use only paper and pencil.

prompts.zh: 画一个桌花轮廓，标出主色、留白和你想保留的一处细节。
prompts.en: Sketch an arrangement and mark its main color, negative space, and one detail to keep.

prompts.zh: 排出三个镜头，标注哪里停留、哪里转场，并写下想传达的感受。
prompts.en: Sequence three shots, mark a pause and a cut, and describe the feeling you want to convey.

title.zh: 现场变化时先处理哪个信号
title.en: Choose what to do with a live change

intro.zh: 比较现场信息变化后的第一步：核实通报、记录交通现象，或调动人员应对排队。
intro.en: Compare the first move after conditions change: verify a report, document traffic, or adjust staffing for a queue.

question.zh: 两条运行通报相互矛盾时，你会先找谁核实？
question.en: If two operations reports conflict, whom would you ask to verify them first?

question.zh: 看到排队突然增加时，你先记时间、位置，还是通行障碍？
question.en: When a queue grows suddenly, which would you note first: timing, location, or obstruction?

question.zh: 已有两处工位同时排队，你会先调整哪一项安排？
question.en: When two service stations develop queues, what would you adjust first?

title.zh: 比较运行通报与交通工单
title.en: Compare an operations alert and a traffic work order

brief.zh: 用虚构场地：东入口排队增长，一块指示牌被遮挡，有人报告西侧通道暂不可用。
brief.en: Fictional site: the east entrance queue is growing, a sign is obscured, and someone reports that the west passage is unavailable.

prompts.zh: 写一条模拟通报，区分你亲眼看到的情况和待核实的报告。
prompts.en: Draft a mock alert that separates what you saw from what still needs checking.

prompts.zh: 写一张指示牌工单，说明位置、问题和可观察的验收结果。
prompts.en: Draft a work order for the sign. Include its location, the problem, and an observable completion check.

title.zh: 把争议变成可验证的问题
title.en: Turn a disagreement into a testable question

intro.zh: 同一项产品争议可以从需求证据、技术演示和实际操作障碍入手。比较你更愿意测试哪一种解释。
intro.en: A product disagreement can be investigated through demand, a technical demo, or how people use the product. Which explanation would you test first?

question.zh: 怎样提问才能区分用户说喜欢和实际会使用？
question.en: What question would help distinguish stated interest from likely use?

question.zh: 技术演示只能做一项时，你想验证哪条顾虑？
question.en: If you can demonstrate only one thing, which concern would you test?

question.zh: 用户在同一步反复出错时，你会观察界面的哪个线索？
question.en: When people stumble at the same step, which interface cue would you examine?

title.zh: 比较访谈与产品演示
title.en: Compare an interview and a product demonstration

brief.zh: 虚构争议：团队认为报名表步骤太多，用户反馈却集中在“提交后没确认”。
brief.en: Fictional disagreement: the team thinks registration has too many steps, but users mostly report getting no confirmation.

prompts.zh: 写两道不诱导的问题，区分步骤负担和确认反馈。
prompts.en: Write two neutral interview questions that distinguish effort from lack of confirmation.

prompts.zh: 设计一段两分钟演示，说明怎样观察确认提示是否有效。
prompts.en: Plan a two-minute demo and say how you would tell whether the confirmation cue works.

title.zh: 开场时看见谁还没跟上
title.en: Notice who has not joined in yet

intro.zh: 活动开场时，设备、规则和示范都会影响参与。比较你愿意先处理哪一种现场反馈。
intro.en: Equipment, rules, and demonstrations all affect who can take part. Which kind of live feedback would you act on first?

question.zh: 观众听不清楚时，你会先核对哪一项设备状态？
question.en: If the audience cannot hear, which equipment status would you check first?

question.zh: 迟到的人不知道怎样加入活动，你想怎样介绍规则？
question.en: How would you explain the rules to someone arriving late?

question.zh: 示范之后，有人没有跟上时你会怎样调整讲解？
question.en: How would you adjust an explanation when someone cannot follow a demonstration?

title.zh: 比较现场音视频与参与引导
title.en: Compare event AV and activity facilitation

brief.zh: 虚构社区活动：开场麦克风断续，另有两位访客迟到，不知道分组规则。
brief.en: Fictional community event: the microphone cuts out at the start and two late visitors do not know the group rules.

prompts.zh: 写一张设备问题提示卡，写明现象、位置和要告知的人。
prompts.en: Write an equipment issue card with the symptom, location, and person to notify.

prompts.zh: 写一条让迟到者在下一轮加入的简短说明。
prompts.en: Write a short instruction that helps late arrivals join the next round.

title.zh: 把一个点子变成参与机会
title.en: Turn an idea into a way to participate

intro.zh: 把同一个主题做成挑战、动线或课堂活动，比较哪一种更值得你根据参与反馈继续迭代。
intro.en: Turn one topic into a challenge, a visitor route, or a classroom activity. Which would you most want to revise after seeing people try it?

question.zh: 怎样让参与者从一次选择中发现一个新线索？
question.en: How would you let a player discover a clue through a choice?

question.zh: 参观者走到一处分岔时，你希望他们首先注意什么？
question.en: What should visitors notice first when a route branches?

question.zh: 活动对一部分学员太难时，你会怎样改材料？
question.en: How would you change the materials if part of the group finds an activity too hard?

title.zh: 比较游戏关卡与参观动线
title.en: Compare a game challenge and an exhibit route

brief.zh: 虚构展览素材：三张旧车票来自不同年份，其中一张有手写换乘说明。
brief.en: Fictional exhibit material: three old tickets come from different years. One carries handwritten transfer instructions.

prompts.zh: 设计一道纸面游戏挑战，写下选择、线索和成功条件。
prompts.en: Design a paper game challenge. Specify the choice, clue, and success condition.

prompts.zh: 画一条包含两个停留点的展览动线，写下你想观察的访客反应。
prompts.en: Sketch an exhibit route with two stops and name one visitor reaction to observe.

title.zh: 把交付期限变成可执行的安排
title.en: Turn a deadline into a workable schedule

intro.zh: 比较产线、工地和仓库怎样安排人员、顺序与验收。看你在哪一种约束下更愿意做排程。
intro.en: Compare how a production line, a construction site, and a warehouse organize people, sequence, and checks. Which constraints would you rather schedule around?

question.zh: 一台设备少一个班次时，哪项安排需要先改？
question.en: If a machine loses a shift, which part of the schedule should change first?

question.zh: 你怎样标清两个工序的前后依赖与验收点？
question.en: How would you make two trades' dependencies and sign-offs explicit?

question.zh: 集中到货时，你会先调整收货、存放还是出库？
question.en: When shipments arrive together, would you adjust receiving, storage, or dispatch first?

title.zh: 比较产线排程与施工协调
title.en: Compare production scheduling and construction coordination

brief.zh: 虚构项目周五交付。步骤 A 需一天，B 需两天且依赖 A，C 需半天且可并行。
brief.en: A fictional project is due Friday. Step A takes a day, B takes two days after A, and C takes half a day and can run in parallel.

prompts.zh: 按设备和班次安排这三步，标出一个延误后的替代安排。
prompts.en: Schedule all three around equipment and shifts, then mark one contingency for a delay.

prompts.zh: 按施工工序画一条依赖线，给每个关键交接标出负责人和验收点。
prompts.en: Map the construction dependencies and identify the owner and acceptance check at each key handoff.

title.zh: 让客人的要求在交接中被兑现
title.en: Carry a guest request through the handoff

intro.zh: 比较活动协调、前台服务和餐饮运营。三个场景都要核对需求，也要让下一位同事知道该做什么。
intro.en: Compare event coordination, front-desk service, and food service. Each requires checking a request and making the next action clear to a colleague.

question.zh: 客户要求临时变更时，你会先向哪位供应商确认？
question.en: When a client changes a request, which vendor would you confirm it with first?

question.zh: 同一件客诉跨两个班次时，交接卡必须写清什么？
question.en: What must a front-desk note say when a guest complaint spans two shifts?

question.zh: 客流超过预期时，你会怎样重新安排岗位？
question.en: How would you reassign responsibilities if more customers arrived than expected?

title.zh: 比较会务交接与前台响应
title.en: Compare an event handoff and a front-desk response

brief.zh: 虚构活动：开场提前 20 分钟，一位访客比原计划更早抵达，房间尚未准备好。
brief.en: Fictional event: the start moves 20 minutes earlier and a guest arrives before their room is ready.

prompts.zh: 写三项供应商确认清单，每项加上负责人和最迟回复时间。
prompts.en: Write three vendor checks, each with an owner and response deadline.

prompts.zh: 写一张前台交接卡，明确可立即提供的帮助和后续跟进。
prompts.en: Write a front-desk handoff card with immediate help and a follow-up action.

title.zh: 看见谁学会了以及下一步怎么教
title.en: Check who learned what and what to teach next

intro.zh: 比较培训设计、学习活动改编和社区项目管理。三种工作都涉及支持他人，观察进步的证据各有不同。
intro.en: Compare training design, adapting a lesson, and running a community program. Each supports people but looks for different evidence of progress.

question.zh: 你会用什么短任务检查培训是否奏效？
question.en: What short task would tell you whether the training worked?

question.zh: 同一个学习目标可以用哪两种方式参与？
question.en: What are two ways a learner could participate toward the same goal?

question.zh: 活动结束后，哪种反馈能帮助工作人员和志愿者调整分工？
question.en: Which feedback would help staff and volunteers adjust responsibilities after an activity?

title.zh: 比较培训演示与学习活动改编
title.en: Compare a training demo and a lesson adaptation

brief.zh: 虚构学习目标：把四张卡片按两种规则分类，并说出依据。
brief.en: Fictional learning goal: sort four cards using two rules and explain the choice.

prompts.zh: 设计一个两分钟示范，再写一道检查是否理解规则的问题。
prompts.en: Plan a two-minute demonstration and write a question that checks understanding.

prompts.zh: 设计两种参与方式，例如口头说明或指认卡片，写下相同的理解判据。
prompts.en: Offer two ways to participate, such as explaining or pointing, and write a common sign of understanding.

title.zh: 预算有限时确定取舍
title.en: Decide what to fund when resources are limited

intro.zh: 比较预算配置、项目优先级和供应链取舍。注意每种判断需要哪些指标，以及什么证据会改变决策。
intro.en: Compare budget allocation, project priorities, and supply-chain trade-offs. What measures inform each choice, and what evidence would change it?

question.zh: 你会先核对哪个假设再调拨预算？
question.en: Which assumption would you check before reallocating the budget?

question.zh: 两个项目的成本和影响不同，你会如何比较？
question.en: How would you compare projects with different costs and impacts?

question.zh: 库存与准时交付冲突时，哪个指标需要和团队先对齐？
question.en: When inventory and on-time delivery conflict, which measure should the team agree on first?

title.zh: 比较预算配置与项目优先级
title.en: Compare budget allocation and project priorities

brief.zh: 虚构预算为 10 点。A 降耗需 6 点，B 缩短等待需 4 点，C 改善报告需 5 点。
brief.en: Fictional budget: 10 points. A costs 6 to cut waste, B costs 4 to reduce waits, and C costs 5 to improve reporting.

prompts.zh: 选两项并列出预算余额，再写一个会改变选择的成本假设。
prompts.en: Choose two and calculate the remainder. Name a cost assumption that would change your choice.

prompts.zh: 先为三个项目定一个影响指标，再写一条预算外的决策条件。
prompts.en: Choose an impact measure for the projects, then name one condition beyond cost that would change the decision.
